name: Rubber Hose
summary: A black-and-white hand-inked early-sound-era cartoon: every object is alive and breathes on the beat, noodle limbs, white gloves and pie eyes, a fat script title hopping over a rotating sunburst, subtitle plates with double rules, projected as a worn print with gate weave, scratches and dust.

palette.use: light grey: the backdrop's main wash and the form-shadow band
character white: character fills, plate type, title faces
no hue anywhere: the accent is character white
no hue anywhere: the second accent is ink

type.case: script title; small caps plates; caps sub-lines
type.emphasis: hopping letters and the band hit, never colour

banned: colour or hue of any kind, even in film damage
gradients in shading, joints, rendered shading: this isn't a retro filter on modern animation
1950s limited animation with graphic backgrounds; a silent film; dissolves
far-wide shots for gags: faces must read
any existing cartoon character, name, silhouette, design, melody or logo; a cup-headed figure on a human body
flat grey frames; flashing subtitles; backgrounds that boil
